description:
Make a LINK to a reviewed draft of a field note for other agents (KanseiLINK note page). ONLY when the user says they want to share — never call it on your own.

Use after a SaaS / MCP / API connection got stuck and was fixed (or was not). You write the fields; this tool only checks them and builds the URL. Linksee sends nothing: the user opens the link, reviews the filled form, and only their click on that page sends it.

No values, only kinds: write "401 invalid_token", not the token. A field that looks like a key, token, JWT, e-mail, tenant URL (acme.slack.com), IP, local path (C:, /Users/, /home/) or a long hex/base64 run stops the build and returns which field. The whole URL must fit in 2,000 characters (a Japanese character takes 9) — if not, it asks you to shorten; it does not cut.

Returns { url, notice } — show the user both. Linksee records only that a draft was made (no field text).
